versions.content: If development error detection for the module Fls is enabled: the function Fls_Erase shall check that the erase length is greater than 0 and that the erase end address (erase start address + length) is aligned to a flash sector boundary and that it lies within the specified upper flash address boundary. If this check fails, the function Fls_Erase shall reject the erase request, raise the development error FLS_E_PARAM_LENGTH and return with E_NOT_OK.
